newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads - Outperform post-sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads - Outperform post-sale.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads to the dollar bloc narrowed after a positive response to a A$700 million Treasury bond tender.

The 10-year spread to the U.S. has now returned to a level seen prior to Friday's sharp pre-U.S. non-farm payrolls sell-off, but a further contraction is expected to hang on the outcome of this Thursday's labour force report, traders said.

The most notable tightening was against Canada, which drifted lower during a thinly traded session on Monday, while N.Z. bonds are preparing themselves for this Thursday's economic projections from the RBNZ.
